name: print-social-orange-marketing-expert-post-with-wave-cut-panels
title: 'Digital Marketing Expert' post with an orange gradient wave panel and wave-cut corners
whatItIs: A square post with a photo of a smiling man sipping coffee, an orange gradient panel with a curved top edge holding a white headline and 'Join us' tag, a wave-cut white corner with an 'Agency' logo, and a white bottom-right wave carrying contact info.
whatItMeans: Smooth and friendly; flowing curves soften the corporate message.
techniques: Cut panels with flowing wave edges.
Outline curves with a thin coloured stroke.
Carry the gradient from orange to red-orange for depth.

vocabulary.definition: A shape filled with a colour fade.
